As technology becomes an integral part of day to day lives, the number of people suffering from internet addiction increased greatly. This causes people to lose their identity as they sacrifice their interests and quality relationships for screen time. This issues is prominent not only causing individuals to lose their identity but it's regressing strong communities and our unified identity as humans.
